note.question: How should an online platform set a pass/fail quality-certification standard when sellers can also make costly verifiable disclosures, and how does the answer differ under commission and listing-fee revenue?
note.overview: The article characterizes perfect Bayesian equilibria in which the platform sets a pass/fail certification standard, certification follows automatically from verified quality, and privately informed sellers then decide platform participation, voluntary disclosure, and pricing.

components.label: Model sequence and system structure
components.explanation: Given the applicable commission rate or listing fee, the platform first chooses q_C, verifies seller quality, and automatically certifies sellers with q_i >= q_C. Each seller then decides whether to participate on the platform and whether to make a costly verifiable disclosure, and subsequently sets price. Consumers observe certification, disclosure, and price, update beliefs, and purchase or not. Bayesian signaling game platform-led certification game
